q: Between the capillaries and the cells is a watery liquid called ____.
e: Between the capillaries and the cells is a watery liquid called tissue fluid. The blank is tissue fluid.

q: Most of the water from tissue fluid reenters capillaries by ____.
e: Most of the water from tissue fluid reenters capillaries by osmosis. That missing piece is osmosis.

q: Some fluid passes into another system called the ____ system.
e: Some fluid passes into another system called the lymphatic system. That missing piece is lymphatic.

q: The ____ that carry fats from villi of the small intestine are part of the lymphatic system.
e: The lacteals that carry fats from villi of the small intestine are part of the lymphatic system. That missing piece is lacteals.

q: Before lymph passes back into the blood, it is ____ to remove dead cells and bacteria.
e: Before lymph passes back into the blood, it is filtered to remove dead cells and bacteria. That missing piece is filtered.
